evidence.mission_note: As a future keeper this is the preferred S52 manual variant at a price inside the ideal band, so it does not conflict with cash preservation. However, it offers no documentation to show it is superior to the many comparable peers.
evidence.rationale: The listing establishes a 1998 Z3 M Roadster, a manual (confirmed in photos), in green metallic over black, asking $16,500 against a fair-value mid of $16,856. The photos show good exterior gloss and straight panels. They also show visible driver-seat bolster and steering-wheel wear, faded carpet and an aftermarket Kenwood head unit, and the seller discloses that the power top no longer works electrically. Brake, caliper and tire freshness are seller claims with no receipts or date codes. There is no VIN, no history report and no service records. The two model-critical items, rear-structure condition and cooling history, are entirely missing; the S54 rod-bearing item does not apply to this S52 car. The listing has been up about a year with a pending/relist cycle, and PPI access in Virginia Beach is unstated.
evidence.next_action: Message the seller asking for the VIN, trunk-floor and underside photos, tire DOT codes and any receipts, and ask whether a PPI at a Hampton Roads BMW independent can happen before any deposit.
